loading.title: Preparing your Exchange workspace
loading.body: The authorized organization and locality projection are loading. Your activation state remains preserved.

empty.title: No authorized organization projection is available
empty.body: Return to activation to complete or repair the organization, geography, profile, or marker requirements.

error.title: The workspace could not be prepared
error.body: No organization or geography state was changed. Retry the authenticated workspace or return to activation for recovery.

permission.title: This organization workspace is not available to your account
permission.body: Access is resolved from current organization membership and restrictions. Private organization details are not displayed.

expired.title: Your workspace session has expired
expired.body: Sign in again to re-evaluate current organization authority and return to the permitted workspace.

recovery.title: Workspace recovery is available
recovery.body: Your organization remains intact. Re-open activation to resolve the missing workspace projection without creating a duplicate organization.

search.lowDensity: Only authorized real organizations are shown.
search.noResultsTitle: No permitted organizations match this search
search.noResultsBody: Try a broader capability or remove the service-area filter. The Exchange does not fabricate results.

match.disclaimer: Matching explains profile overlap. It is not qualification, endorsement, or guaranteed eligibility.

home.projectionMetadata: Projection observed through the authenticated organization workspace.
home.viewportBody: Organization home is restored deterministically on entry.
home.scopeBody: This environment shows authoritative organization, approved geography, map position, profile access, and permitted Network organization discovery. Opportunities, referrals, resource providers, credibility, and outcomes remain absent until their authorized slices are complete.

detail.noServiceAreas: No public service areas are listed.
detail.capabilityEvidence: What this organization says it can do
detail.profileEvidence: Organization profile and capability information is organization-provided unless separately identified as verified. Discovery does not certify capability, performance, or eligibility.

actionReasons.self-only: Only members of this organization can manage its profile.
actionReasons.not-an-official-provider: This organization has no published Official Resource Provider services.
actionReasons.exchange-action-unavailable: This action is not available yet. You can continue exploring the Exchange.
